The '''Galactic Species Preservation Society''' functioned during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. The [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] scientist [[Daru'da]] contacted the Society with the plans to recreate the extinct [[shanjaru]] using genetic samples.<ref name="SOS">{{TORcite|type=class|[[Voidhound|Smuggler]]|Survival of a Species|[[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]}}</ref>
